================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO BAKENG SA AFTER EFFECTS - DILO TŠE MPSHA
Kgatišo 9.2.9  -  Oktobore 2026
================================================================================

Di-THEME TŠA ANIME tše 33 tše mpsha di tlaleletša tša Demon Slayer, di-effect tša mouse tša di-theme bjale
di bonagala ka nnete ka gare ga After Effects, gomme Theme Selector bjale ke dropdown e tee ye e rulagantšwego.

PELE O THOMA
- Kenya godimo ga kgatišo ya gago ya bjale ka ZXP installer ya gago ya ka mehla, ke moka o thome
  After Effects gape ka lekga le tee.
- Dipeakanyo tša gago, theme, di-preset le di-expression tše o di bolokilego di a bolokwa.

E MPSHA: DI-THEME TŠA ANIME TŠE 33
- Dipeakanyo tša Flex > THEME SELECTOR > THEME YA PANEL bjale di na le sehlopha se tee go anime ye nngwe le ye nngwe:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan
  (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal
  Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu
  Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero
  Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) le Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Semelo se sengwe le se sengwe se na le ponagalo ya sona: seo se latelago mouse ya gago, tlhaselo ge
  o click button, seo se diregago ge o swere button ya ka letshadi, le
  go phatloga ka morago ga go swara disekhondi tše ka bago 2.5.
- Di bonolo go swana le di-theme tša Demon Slayer: di-effect di šoma feela ge o
  šuthiša mouse goba o click. Tima AMBIENT EFFECTS gore o boloke mebala feela.

E FETOŠITŠWE: THEME SELECTOR
- Di-card tša Demon Slayer ka fase ga THEME YA PANEL di tlošitšwe, ka fao Dipeakanyo tša Flex
  di kopana go feta pele. Kgetha theme ye nngwe le ye nngwe go dropdown ya THEME YA PANEL; e bulega go
  theme yeo o e šomišago.
- Kurama le Baryon bjale ba ka sehlopheng sa Naruto.

E TOKIŠITŠWE
- Di-effect tša mouse tša di-theme (meetse, malakabe, legadima le tše dingwe) gantši di be di sa
  bonagale ka gare ga After Effects, le ge Optimised Mode e be e timilwe. Dinako tšeo panele ka boyona
  e bego e swaregile, le go thoma mo go swaregilego, di be di tšewa bjalo ka ge theme e diega, ka fao
  di-effect di be di itima. Bjale, ge graphics card ya gago e di thala
  (dikhomphutheng tše ntši), dinako tšeo di dira feela gore di-effect di be bonolo nakwana.

TŠE DI SA FETOGAGO
- Layisense, activation le link ye nngwe le ye nngwe di šoma ka mo go swanago le pele.
- Di-theme tše 11 tša Demon Slayer di bonagala ka mo go swanago le ka 9.2.8.
- Di-tab tše dingwe ka moka le didirišwa di šoma ka mo go swanago le ka 9.2.8.
================================================================================

Kgatišo 2.2.9  -  Oktobore 2026

Di-THEME TŠA ANIME tše 33 tše mpsha di tlaleletša tša Demon Slayer, di-effect tša mouse tša di-theme ga di sa
itima ge panele e swaregile, Theme Selector ke dropdown e tee ye e rulagantšwego, gomme
melaetša ya netefatšo ga e sa iphihla ka morago ga Dipeakanyo tša Flex.

PELE O THOMA
- Kenya godimo ga kgatišo ya gago ya bjale ka ZXP installer ya gago ya ka mehla, ke moka o thome
  Premiere Pro gape ka lekga le tee.
- Dipeakanyo tša gago, theme le di-preset di a bolokwa.

E MPSHA: DI-THEME TŠA ANIME TŠE 33
- Dipeakanyo tša Flex > THEME SELECTOR > THEME YA PANEL bjale di na le sehlopha se tee go anime ye nngwe le ye nngwe:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan
  (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal
  Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu
  Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero
  Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) le Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Semelo se sengwe le se sengwe se na le ponagalo ya sona: seo se latelago mouse ya gago, tlhaselo ge
  o click button, seo se diregago ge o swere button ya ka letshadi, le
  go phatloga ka morago ga go swara disekhondi tše ka bago 2.5.
- Di bonolo go swana le di-theme tša Demon Slayer: di-effect di šoma feela ge o
  šuthiša mouse goba o click. Tima AMBIENT EFFECTS gore o boloke mebala feela.

E FETOŠITŠWE: THEME SELECTOR
- Di-card tša Demon Slayer ka fase ga THEME YA PANEL di tlošitšwe, ka fao Dipeakanyo tša Flex
  di kopana go feta pele. Kgetha theme ye nngwe le ye nngwe go dropdown ya THEME YA PANEL; e bulega go
  theme yeo o e šomišago.
- Kurama le Baryon bjale ba ka sehlopheng sa Naruto.

E TOKIŠITŠWE
- Di-effect tša mouse tša di-theme (meetse, malakabe, legadima le tše dingwe) di be di ka
  itima ka gare ga Premiere Pro: dinako tšeo panele ka boyona e bego e swaregile, le go thoma mo

  thala (dikhomphutheng tše ntši), dinako tšeo di dira feela gore di-effect di be bonolo
  nakwana.
- Go kgetha theme ka Dipeakanyo tša Flex go be go sa dire selo seo o ka se bonago: molaetša wa “Na
  o nyaka go diriša theme ye le ge go le bjalo?” o be o bulega o utilwe ka morago ga Dipeakanyo tša Flex gomme o
  bonagala feela ka morago ga ge o tswaletše Dipeakanyo tša Flex. Bjale molaetša o bonagala ka godimo. Go swana
  le ka RESET DATHA KA MOKA le melaetša ye mengwe ya netefatšo yeo e bulwago go tšwa go window.
- Ge BEAKANYA FOOTER e timilwe ka Dipeakanyo tša Flex, melaetša ya netefatšo e be e sa kgone
  go bonagala le gatee. Bjale e dula e bonagala.
- Dropdown ya THEME YA PANEL e be e ka tšwela pele go bontšha leina la theme ya kgale ka morago ga
  ge theme e fetogile. Bjale e dula e bontšha theme yeo e šomago.

TŠE DI SA FETOGAGO
- Layisense, activation le link ye nngwe le ye nngwe di šoma ka mo go swanago le pele.
- Di-theme tše 11 tša Demon Slayer di bonagala ka mo go swanago le ka 2.2.8.
- Di-tab tše dingwe ka moka le didirišwa di šoma ka mo go swanago le ka 2.2.8.
